statements.status_notes: Uncontrolled resource consumption in io.netty.handler.codec.compression.Lz4FrameDecoder. The vulnerable class is in netty-codec, embedded only inside the Cassandra Java driver shaded uber-jars (cql-*.jar, persistence-api-*.jar, persistence-cassandra-4.0-*.jar). The Cassandra binary protocol uses its own LZ4 implementation (org.lz4:lz4-java) for optional frame compression negotiated via the STARTUP message; it does not place netty's Lz4FrameDecoder in the channel pipeline. The class is loadable on the driver's classpath but is never instantiated. Upstream fix in 4.1.133.Final is pinned via mvn-properties netty.version, but the cassandra-driver shaded jars carry their own pre-shaded 4.1.132.Final copies that the property override cannot rewrite.
